title.narrative: WTO Fisheries Funding Mechanism Trust Fund 2023-2025

description.narrative:
This trust fund is being established to support the targeted implementation of new fisheries subsidies disciplines by eligible developing country and least developed country (LDC) WTO Members by providing them with technical assistance and capacity building support.
The key deliverable is a successful implementation of the fisheries subsidies disciplines. This will be done through the integration by Members of fisheries-related elements into their fisheries subsidies policies and practices, and the notification and reporting of the information related to the subsidies and the fisheries-related elements to the WTO. The TACB provided will also assist beneficiary Members to have strengthened fisheries management to meet the specific requirements of the Agreement.
It is aimed principally at countering the harm that subsidies can cause to the sustainability of fish stocks. As such, the disciplines require Members, when providing fisheries subsidies, to take into account in various ways information and considerations related to the sustainability of the fisheries in question.
